answer: Admission runs through a sponsor pool. The nth agent under one pearl needs a fresh unrelated sponsor, and every sponsor in that pool must raise its locked pearl to n before the glacier records the delta. Ten agents leave ten sponsors each holding ten pearl, 100 pearl tied up; a newcomer's first agent leaves one sponsor holding one. The glacier keys one pool to the operator's pearl, and a replacement pearl must carry the old pool's sponsor count, so fragmenting buys no discount.
